deploybot: :rocket: Staging deploy started — env=staging, git_ref=refs/tags/v1.6.2, commit=3f9b2a7, initiated_by=@jordan. change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. starting canary at 5%
jordan: Kicking off smoke now, will monitor p95 and error rates. tagging @sara for pin decision if things look off.
sara: Thanks — criteria I care about: P95 > 120ms for >1min OR error rate >1% on rerank/serve routes.
ci-smoke: smoke tests running:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --env=staging --tag=v1.6.2
[1/12] auth ok
[2/12] frontend ok
[3/12] reranker ok (warn: latency spike at check 45s)
...
```
ci-smoke: smoke results: 12/12 checks passed, 1 warning on reranker latency (transient). logs: https://ci.internal/smoke/1756102468
mike: seeing a P95 bump to ~250ms on reranker fetch at t=45s, looks batching related. increasing tracing on that service.
jordan: Holding traffic shift at 30% until we get a stable reranker baseline. @deploybot please pause further traffic shift.
deploybot: :pause_button: Traffic shift paused at 30% per request from @jordan. reason="reranker p95 spike". auto-rollforward disabled.
sara: I'm going to request a pin to v1.6.1 for the rerank route if we don't get steady numbers in 10m. filing pin request now.
anita: +1 to pin if we can't get P95 under 150ms within the window. also suggest toggling smaller batch on canary nodes.
jordan: Agreed. I'll roll a small config tweak to reduce batch size on the canary group and rerun smoke.
ci-smoke: rerun smoke started for canary group; quick result: core checks pass, reranker P95 back to ~110ms. flagging the earlier spike as transient.
sara: reranker looks back in range. withdrawing pin request. will reopen if it reoccurs in the next 15m.
deploybot: :white_check_mark: Deploy complete (staging). final_state: traffic=30% (paused), tag=v1.6.2, commit=3f9b2a7, artifacts=s3://releases/v1.6.2/, duration=00:04:20. notes="canary paused after transient reranker spike; manual pin was prepared but not applied."
